survey: A round wall clock seen almost straight on, hung flat against a background of vertical green stripes. The thick orange rim is a near-perfect circle, and its rounded depth shows evenly all the way around, which fits a face-on view. The white dial sits inside the rim, centred and parallel to it. The 12 hour marks and the ring of minute dots are spaced evenly in a circle and all point to the centre, so they lie flat on the dial and turn with it. The hour, minute and red second hands come from one navy hub in the centre and lie flat on the dial. A soft shadow down and to the left places the clock just in front of the wall, matching the wall's front-on view. The vertical stripes stay vertical and agree with the camera.
